# Features

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

GeoJSON written into the node (a FeatureCollection, a Feature or a bare geometry) or WKT, as a table of features. What a drawing tool writes.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "features", "name": "features", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
